description.html: The SOBO L-28C is a 2.8 W mini LED clip light, which the packaging says is specially designed for nano tanks. The clip attaches to the glass rim, and the flexible neck lets you aim the light exactly where you want it. Thanks to its low wattage, the lamp uses very little power.

The lamp comes with a red, black or white housing, so it is easy to match to your aquarium and furniture. It suits small open-top tanks, betta and shrimp tanks and fish bowls, where a larger lamp would not fit. Call us for the colors currently in stock.

Switch aquarium lighting on and off at the same times every day, ideally with a timer, so fish and plants have a steady day-night rhythm. Too much light and direct sunlight encourage algae. Wipe limescale and dust off the lamp from time to time, as deposits reduce light output.
